estate.source: Cloudflare account zone inventory + Web Analytics site inventory

globaldeetsTraffic.note: Raw edge visits are materially contaminated by operational health traffic and must not be presented as human audience traction.

gaps.title: Certify human audience metrics
gaps.observed: Raw edge visits include synthetic health traffic
gaps.target: Human/bot/monitor/API/asset traffic classified before investor display
gaps.nextAction: Automate RUM ingestion and certify human page-load/visitor metrics with explicit exclusions.

gaps.title: Close estate browser-observability gaps
gaps.observed: 21 of 25 active zones have Web Analytics/RUM coverage
gaps.target: 25 of 25 active zones observed or explicitly exempted
gaps.nextAction: Enable or explicitly exempt Web Analytics for the four uncovered zones and re-audit automatically.

gaps.title: Replace stale portfolio-era narrative
gaps.observed: README.md and STATUS.md describe an obsolete portfolio product and contain estimated performance claims
gaps.target: Repository narrative matches the current source-first intelligence product and cites verifiable evidence
gaps.nextAction: Rewrite README/STATUS and add stale-claim detection to the diagnostics contract.

gaps.title: Instrument business conversion events
gaps.observed: No certified investor-facing funnel for donor, partner, subscriber, or investor-intent conversion is represented here
gaps.target: Named conversion events and funnel stages with source, date window, and attribution limits
gaps.nextAction: Define business events and connect Stripe/donation and first-party intent telemetry without fabricating revenue metrics.

gaps.title: Unify estate health and availability
gaps.observed: Traffic and content observability exist, but cross-property availability/performance is not yet represented in this surface
gaps.target: Estate-wide status, latency, deploy freshness, and critical-path checks
gaps.nextAction: Ingest production health checks for every active property and rank failures by user/business impact.

gaps.title: Quantify CultureSherpa convergence opportunity
gaps.observed: CultureSherpa is a separate high-potential property linked conceptually to GlobalDeets
gaps.target: Evidence-backed integration thesis with shared audience/content/product metrics
gaps.nextAction: Measure overlap, unique utility, and migration/integration options before product convergence decisions.
